issues.description: The problem statement (UML and text) specifies orderMeal(Meal) as returning void, but the solution implementation declares orderMeal(Meal) with a boolean return type. This mismatch in the method return type can confuse students about the expected signature and behavior and may cause test or grading harness incompatibilities.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent. Either change the solution to implement public void orderMeal(Meal meal) (removing boolean returns) to match the problem statement, or update the problem statement/UML to specify a boolean return type and explain the meaning of the boolean result. Preferably, align the solution to the specified void signature so students implement the method as described.
